headline: Philippine Shares Rise as Peso Drops to New Record Low
summary: Philippine equities gained on bargain hunting, while the Philippine peso sank to a fresh record low against the dollar ahead of the central bank's policy meeting.
why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas manages policy interest rates to support the local currency and maintain domestic price stability.

impacts.name: Philippine Peso
impacts.why: The peso fell to a record low against the US dollar amid pre-meeting currency pressures.

why_moved: Equities advanced on local bargain hunting, while persistent dollar strength dragged the Philippine peso to an all-time low ahead of the central bank's rate decision.
